svg.text: Herb-drug clashes: natural is NOT safe

g.text: "NATURAL = SAFE" KILLS: hemlock is natural; arsenic is natural; DOSE makes poison
(Paracelsus!). Herbs = DRUGS with unknown doses + unknown purity + real pharmacology.
BLEEDERS: garlic + ginger + ginkgo + ginseng + high-dose vitamin E + warfarin/heparin/
aspirin = bleeding (gums! nose! surgical! GI!). Stop 7-14 days pre-op (M03.2!). Teach:
CANCELLERS (CYP450!): St John's wort induces enzymes → eats ARVs (resistance! death!) +
contraceptive pills (pregnancies!) + transplant drugs (rejection!) + warfarin. ASK every
HIV/TB/family-planning client: "bush teas for mood/sleep…?" — kindly, lifesavingly.
HYPO STACKS: bitter leaf + glibenclamide/insulin = crashes (sweats! confusion! coma!).
Teach BGL logs + hypo signs + separate/adjust + never double-dose ("herb OR drug day" —
no! coordinate BOTH with the doctor!).
ORGAN HITTERS: liver (kava! chaparral! heavy neem! — yellow eyes? dark urine? STOP + LFTs!)
· kidneys (aristolochia! NSAID-like! — swelling? less urine?) · heart (stimulant herbs +
palpitations? — ECG!). Unexplained organ injury? ASK HERBS FIRST.
ADULTERANTS: "herbal" mixtures hiding STEROIDS (moon face! sugar! — ask!) + sildenafil +
NSAIDs + LEAD/mercury (market ayurvedics!) + alcohol. Unregistered = suspect. FDA
MANTRA: "dose makes poison — ask every herb, check every clash."
